declared: 2026-10-16, before any pilot was chosen, before any teaching material was written and before any Stage 4 request was read
criteria: C1 new to the journey: not in CATEGORY_REGISTRY248/250 and no adopted lesson, so teaching happens upstream of any test
C2 factually evaluable now: evaluation/phase251/observational-knowledge-after.json shows at least 2 products from at least 2 hosts and at least 2 observed attributes

C3 an untouched real-request pool exists: a Stack Exchange site (official API only) holds at least 40 questions matching the category term (count read with filter=total, so no question text is seen before Stage 4 is registered)
C4 lawful public method sources exist: at least one standards, regulator or test-procedure page reachable without robots or access restrictions
C5 diversity: the two pilots differ in technology and domain (one household appliance, one non-appliance), to test whether the teaching method, not the material, transfers
tie_break: most products in the store, then most hosts
candidates_considered: every non-registry category in observational-knowledge-after.json with at least 2 products
